goal: ai-env-audit: comprehensive read-only audit of the AI coding environment
summary: read-only audit of this cloud agent coding environment via orchestrate smoke run
acceptanceCriteria: Final report at audit/AI-ENV-AUDIT-REPORT.md covers runtime, toolchain, agent surface (skills/MCP/subagents), secrets/egress policy, and orchestrate substrate status
All audit work is read-only; no repo source changes outside audit/ and .orchestrate/ai-env-audit/
Each audit slice cites evidence paths or command output in handoffs

tasks.name: bootstrap-pack
tasks.scopedGoal: Read-only: turn `audit/reference/planner-bootstrap.md` into structured reference files under `audit/reference/` (`inventory-host.json`, `inventory-toolchain.json`, `inventory-agent-store.json`) for downstream workers. Do not run destructive commands. Note in handoff if ai-env-audit SKILL.md was missing and which goal text you used.
acceptance: Three JSON inventory files exist under audit/reference/
Handoff lists any gaps or missing skill provisioning

tasks.name: audit-runtime-egress
tasks.scopedGoal: Read-only audit of host runtime and cloud egress: OS/kernel, user, key paths (/workspace, /cursor/stores, /exec-daemon), environment build resolution, and egress policy. Append findings to `audit/sections/runtime-egress.md` with evidence (commands run, file paths). Use cursor-cloud environment-info if available. No secret values in output.
acceptance: Documents defaultImageFallback / build resolution when present

tasks.name: audit-agent-surface
tasks.scopedGoal: Read-only audit of the AI agent surface available in this VM: mounted user skills under /cursor/stores/user/skills, dynamic MCP namespaces visible to agents, subagent types, and orchestrate substrate path (/tmp/plugins/orchestrate/...). Write `audit/sections/agent-surface.md`. Do not exfiltrate secret values.
acceptance: audit/sections/agent-surface.md lists skills, MCP namespaces, and orchestrate CLI location
Calls out missing ai-env-audit skill mount if still absent

tasks.name: synthesize-report
tasks.scopedGoal: Merge all material under audit/reference/ and audit/sections/ into a single human-readable `audit/AI-ENV-AUDIT-REPORT.md` with executive summary, findings by category, and explicit limitations (missing SKILL.md, missing CURSOR_API_KEY for orchestrate spawn). Read-only synthesis only.
acceptance: audit/AI-ENV-AUDIT-REPORT.md exists with summary + categorized findings
Limitations section mentions skill mount and API key if applicable

tasks.name: verify-audit-report
tasks.scopedGoal: Verify synthesize-report acceptance: report exists, covers runtime+agent surface, states read-only scope, and documents known provisioning gaps. Run no write commands beyond verifier artifacts under verify/ if needed.
acceptance: Verification section maps each synthesize-report acceptance criterion to met/not met with evidence
tasks.verify:
## Automated
- Confirm `audit/AI-ENV-AUDIT-REPORT.md` exists and is non-empty.

## Manual
- Skim report for runtime, agent surface, and limitations sections.
- Confirm no secret values appear in report text.
